en.headline: Lawmaker urges source checks as dog abandonments rise
en.dek: Agriculture-sector legislator Chan Pok-chi said smugglers coach buyers to dodge quarantine, while a welfare group said intakes at one shelter rose at least 50 per cent.
body: After the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said it would prosecute three owners found during Sunday patrols without large dogs on leashes, lawmaker Chan Pok-chi told RTHK that immediate enforcement without a prior warning can deter breaches, but longer-term work is still needed.

Chan, who represents the agriculture and fisheries sector, said dog smuggling has continued and that some sellers coach buyers on how to avoid quarantine and AFCD checks. He called for cross-department action against the source, including the use of drones to inspect kennels, and suggested members of the public send photographs of suspected breaches or fighting breeds through an app or an upgraded 1823 hotline. He also proposed voluntary courses for owners who had not thought through the commitment before getting a dog.

Lau Chun-hoi of the Animal Welfare Concern Alliance said recent AFCD visits to collect suspected dangerous dogs had left some owners anxious. He suggested a transition period so owners could declare suspected fighting breeds themselves, saying a sudden removal can change an animal's temperament because of the bond with its keeper.

Lau said some owners had overestimated their ability to keep a dog. Groups under the alliance have taken in more abandoned animals, and the shelter he works with recorded at least a 50 per cent rise compared with the previous month. He said he had personally received at least 16 abandonment cases since recent fatal dog attacks.

zh.headline: 議員倡追截走私狗源頭 團體稱棄養個案升至少五成
zh.dek: 漁農界議員陳博智指有商人教買家規避檢疫；動物福利關注聯盟成員劉鎮海稱所屬機構近月接收棄養數字按月升至少五成。
body: 漁護署昨日在多區巡查，發現三名畜養人涉嫌在公眾地方未用狗帶牽引大型狗隻，將提出檨控。漁農界立法會議員陳博智在港台節目表示，不預先警告即時執法有阻嚎作用，但長遠仍要配合行動部署。
陳博智指走私狗隻一直存在，有不法商人鋺而走險，教買家如何規避隔離及漁護署監管。他認為要跨部門追截源頭，例如用無人機巡視狗場，並建議市民發現違規或懸疑格鬥犬，可用照片經應用程式或優化後的1823熱線提交。他亦建議部分未深思熟慮便養狗的人士自願接受課程。
動物福利關注聯盟成員劉鎮海在同一節目表示，近日漁護署接獲懸疑危險狗隻投訴後上門帶走犬隻，令不少狗主感到不安。他建議設立過渡期，讓主人主動申報懸疑危險狗隻，指主人與狗隻聯繫很深，突然帶走反而可能令性情轉變。
劉鎮海說，部分狗主高估自己的飼養能力，聯盟旗下團體已接收多宗棄養個案，他所屬機構的棄養數字較前一個月上升至少五成。他表示，自從發生一些悲劇後，他本人至少收到16宗棄養個案。
